h7AuraOfCleansing.description:
{Aura of Cleansing}
Self and adjacent allies +${val} Defense; dispels one negative spell per round

h7AuraOfPurity.description:
{Aura of Purity}
Self and adjacent allies can't be targeted by negative spells

h7HeartOfDarkness.description:
{Heart of Darkness}
Self and adjacent allies take -${val}% Light spell damage

h7SHIELDING.description:
{Shielding}
Adjacent allies take -${val}% damage; the Legionnaire takes as much

h7Soulfire.description:
{Soulfire}
Adjacent allies +1 Morale, +${val} Speed until the end of their next turn

h7InspiringPresence.description:
{Inspiring Presence}
Self and adjacent allies +${val} Morale, +${val} Luck

h7AuraOfFire.description:
{Aura of Fire}
Self and adjacent allies are immune to negative Earth spells

h7TreantSynergy.description:
{Treant Symbiosis}
Self and adjacent allies +${val} Defense; heals adjacent Treants after acting

h7GiftOfLife.description:
{Gift of Life}
After acting, heals adjacent First Aid Tent ${val}×Dryad count HP

h7PrimeImmunity.description:
{Prime Immunity}
Immune to negative Prime spells; takes 50% less Prime damage

h7MagmaBlood.description:
{Magma Blood}
Immune to negative Fire spells; one Fire spell kills at most one

h7Nimble.description:
{Nimble}
+${val} Defense when attacked or retaliated on by big creatures

h7DwarvenShieldwall.description:
{Dwarven Shieldwall}
+${val} Defense vs non-rear attacks; can't be disabled by them

h7Defensive.description:
{Defensive Stance}
When defending: unlimited retaliation, no flank or rear attacks, until next turn

h7CritStun.description:
{Breath of Light}
Crit: foes hit lose their next turn.

h7Bash.description:
{Bash}
Crit: target can't retaliate and loses its next turn.

h7SweepingBash.description:
{Sweeping Bash}
Crit: foes hit lose their next turn.

h7BlindingLight.description:
{Blinding Light}
Crit: target loses its next turn.

h7Mesmerize.description:
{Mesmerize}
Crit: target loses its next turn; damage frees it.

h7Petrification.description:
{Petrification}
Crit: target loses its next turn; damage frees it.

h7AcidDot.description:
{Acid Breath}
Foes hit take 50% of this damage next round, 25% the round after.

h7AcidSpit.description:
{Acid Breath}
Foes hit take 50% of this damage next round, 25% the round after.

h7WitheringVenom.description:
{Withering Venom}
Foes hit take growing Dark damage at the start of each round.

h7PoisonedBlades.description:
{Poisoned Blades}
Foes hit take growing Dark damage at the start of each round.

h7Rooting.description:
{Rooting}
Foes hit are slowed; on a crit they can't move at all.

h7CorrodingVenom.description:
{Corroding Venom}
Active attack: target -${val} Defense until the end of its next turn.

h7HexOfDisruption.description:
{Hex of Disruption}
Shots give the target and adjacent foes -${val} Defense.

h7MagicTouch.description:
{Magic Touch}
Attacks put a random negative spell on the target.

h7ChaosShield.description:
{Chaos Shield}
Foes that attack or retaliate on it in melee get a random negative spell.

h7Stranglehold.description:
{Stranglehold}
Grabs single-hex foes when attacking or retaliating.

h7EntanglingRoots.description:
{Entangling Roots}
Foes hit can't move until the Ancient Treant moves or dies.

h7FatalStrike.description:
{Deadly Strike}
Any damage dealt kills at least one enemy.

h7Backstab.description:
{Backstab}
Melee vs a foe already hit by allies this round: +${val}% damage.

h7AuraOfPestilence.description:
{Aura of Pestilence}
At round start, damages and weakens adjacent foes.

h7OpportunityRetaliation.description:
{Opportunity Retaliation}
Retaliates on a foe meleeing an adjacent ally if adjacent, 1/round

h7PiercingShot.description:
{Piercing Shot}
Shots pierce the whole line, hitting all units on it (allies too).

h7PiercingShotApprentice.description:
{Piercing Shot}
Shots pierce the whole line, dealing Fire damage to all on it (allies too).

h7DoubleShot.description:
{Double Shot}
Kills 1+: shoots again; target may retaliate first.

h7OpportunityAttack.description:
{Opportunity Attack}
If not blocked, shoots foes hit in melee (${val}%, 1/round).

h7Wild.description:
{Wild}
After being meleed, until next turn: strikes twice, crits root

h7Rage.description:
{Rage}
After being shot, until its next turn ends: +${damage} damage, +${speed} Speed, Mind immunity

h7HammerOfArkath.description:
{Hammer of Arkath}
Active melee: units next to target take ${val}% as Fire (both sides)

h7Maneuver.description:
{Evasive Maneuver}
In melee: steps back first, then shoots back (${val}%), 1/round

h7MobileShooter.description:
{Mobile Shooter}
Move without attacking: shoots nearest foe after (not if blocked)

h7MagicAbsorption.description:
{Magic Absorption}
Spell damage taken is added to its next attack as Prime damage

h7SoulFlayingBreath.description:
{Soul Flaying Breath}
Breath hits foes on hexes 3-${range} of the line, -${step}% per hex (Dark).

h7ArcaneWings.description:
{Arcane Wings}
At round end, each adjacent foe gets a random negative spell.

h7FireBreath.description:
{Fire Breath}
Hit hexes burn until next round's end: ${val}×count Fire dmg to foes

h7TrailOfFire.description:
{Trail of Fire}
Path burns until next round's end: ${val}×count Fire dmg to foes in it

h7DivingAttackLand.description:
{Swoop Attack}
The Griffin is airborne and swoops down at the start of next round.

h7HammerRefund.description:
{Throwing Hammer}
Only 1 shot; refunded if the hammer kills nothing.

h7RuneAura.description:
{Rune Aura}
An H7 Memorial rune stone is on the battlefield: keeps its aura.

h7RuneShield.description:
{Fortune Rune Shield}
Can absorb ${val} more attack and spell damage; gone when used up.

h7AirBurstTick.description:
{Lightning Burst (H7)}
On this unit's turn, shocks adjacent units with Air damage.

h7AirReflexes.description:
{Lightning Reflexes (H7)}
Strikes an extra time in melee; extra hit Attack ${val}.

h7RegenTick.description:
{Regeneration}
Restores ${val} HP at the start of each round; can revive the dead.

h7PoisonSprayTick.description:
{Poison Spray}
Takes ${val} Earth damage at the start of each round.

h7EntangleTick.description:
{Entangle}
Takes ${val} Earth damage after each move.

h7WaspSwarmJump.description:
{Wasp Swarm}
Luck -2 until turn end, then jumps to another unit of that side (${val} left)

h7ImplosionEcho.description:
{Implosion Echo}
At next round start, takes ${val}% of its total HP then as damage.

h7BurnTick.description:
{Burn}
Takes ${val} Fire damage after its first action each round.

h7ElementalGrow.description:
{Summon Elemental (H7)}
Count +${val} at the start of each round.

h7FireSentry.description:
{Fire Sentry (H7)}
Round end: shoots 2 nearest foes; counters each round's first shooter

range.description: Hexes the obstacle may be placed on, as direction paths from the target hex

animation.description: Looping animation shown while the obstacle is on the battlefield

appearAnimation.description: Animation played when the obstacle appears

appearSound.description: Sound played when the obstacle appears

removalAnimation.description: Animation played when the obstacle is removed. Falls back to appearAnimation if empty

offsetY.description: Vertical offset of the obstacle sprite, in pixels

shape.description: Hexes occupied by the obstacle, as direction paths from the anchor hex

range.description: Hexes the obstacle may be placed on, as direction paths from the target hex

h7CelestialArmor.description:
{Celestial Armor (H7)}
Can absorb ${val} more attack and spell damage; ends when used up or expired.

h7Retribution.description:
{Retribution (H7)}
When attacked and damaged, the attacker takes ${val} Light damage.

h7AgonyTick.description:
{Agony (H7)}
Takes ${val} Dark damage after each action.

h7ElrathTouch.description:
{Elrath's Touch (Resurrection (H7))}
Restores ${val} HP at the start of each round; can resurrect.

h7PurgeCurse.description:
{Curse (Expunge (H7))}
Can't gain buffs; any buff cast on it is removed at once.

h7FaceOfFear.description:
{Face of Fear (H7)}
Attacks frighten foes (Morale -${val}, 3 rounds); melee knocks back ${range} hexes

h7Martyr.description:
{Martyr (H7)}
${val}% of the damage it takes is borne by the Martyr; Morale +1.

h7ShadowCloakSpell.description:
{Shadow Cloak (H7)}
Attacks miss completely until charges run out or it expires (not spells)

h7ImageGuard.description:
{Shadow Cloak (Image)}
Does not vanish on the first attack (spell damage still hits).

h7FreezingOrbTick.description:
{Freezing Orb}
Round end: moves next to foes; adjacent foes take ${val} Water dmg, slowed

h7IceStrikeProc.description:
{Ice Strike (H7)}
On attack and retaliation, foes hit take ${val} extra Water damage.

h7FogShroudBreak.description:
{Fog Shroud (H7)}
The fog dissipates when taking melee damage.

h7VictoriousStreak.description:
{Victorious Streak}
+${val}% damage on extra turns from high Morale.

h7EternalServitude.description:
{Eternal Servitude}
After an active attack, revives ${val}% of its dead (not on retaliation).

h7Coordination.description:
{Coordination}
First unretaliated melee each round: attacks the target again at once

h7NatureLuck.description:
{Nature's Luck}
Always lucky vs foes already hit 2+ times by its side.

h7RuneScattering.description:
{Rune of Scattering}
${val}% of melee damage to foes in aura is shared by other foes in it
